answer.location_description: Small 3x3 square near the top-left corner of the image, at rows 1-3 and columns 1-3.
answer.mechanism: Several layer-1 units have very large weights confined to the 3x3 patch at rows 1-3, columns 1-3, far larger than their weights elsewhere outside the blob. Units 1, 7, 11, 14, 16, 12 and 19 have large positive patch weights (about +55 to +99). Units 1, 7, 11, 14 and 16 are also positive-ring 'large blob' detectors, and 12 and 19 respond to a broad bright centre. Units 3, 5, 8, 10, 17, 20, 23, 25, 30 and 31 are 'small blob' detectors (positive background, negative ring), and they have large negative patch weights (about -30 to -99). In layer 2, the units with positive output weights are fed by the patch-positive units and inhibited by the patch-negative units: u13 (out +99) takes 7:+87, 19:+78, 14:+68, 12:+63 and 17:-92, 25:-87, 5:-78, 8:-76; u8 (out +65) takes 14:+99, 11:+95 and 8:-97, 3:-86; u15 (out +67) takes 11:+97, 19:+81, 1:+79 and 5:-81, 25:-81. The units with negative output weights are wired the opposite way: u9 (out -98) takes 17:+90, 5:+85 and 16:-51; u3 (out -94) takes 17:+87, 25:+87 and 14:-93, 16:-81; u0 and u12 take 7 and 16 negatively. So a bright patch boosts the large-blob pathway and suppresses the small-blob pathway, pushing the logit positive.
answer.evidence: Patch weights (rows 1-3, cols 1-3) by unit: unit 1 has 66 59 98 / 59 96 71 / 70 88 66; unit 7 has 73 62 85 / 73 63 97 / 97 87 89; unit 16 has 83 99 97 / 75 69 71 / 72 71 77; unit 12 has 76 55 86 / 98 95 62 / 83 81 97. In contrast, unit 3 has -91 -78 -84 / -84 -68 -58 / -77 -94 -71, and units 5, 17, 25 and 31 show similar values from -57 to -99. The patch values in each unit are sharply bounded: neighbouring pixels in row 0, row 4, column 0 and column 4 have ordinary small weights. The patch sign always matches the unit's role: it is positive in the large-blob (ring) units and negative in the small-blob (background-positive) units. This consistent alignment, carried through layer 2 to the output, means a bright patch drives the logit toward class 1. Noise-like units (0, 2, 4, 6, 9, 13, 15, 18, 21, 22, 24, 26, 27, 28, 29) show no such patch.
answer.main_feature: Blob size is read from radial structure. Large-blob units weight an annulus at radius of roughly 5-7 pixels around the centre positively. Small-blob units are positive on the dark periphery and negative on that annulus, so bright pixels far from the centre signal a large blob.
